_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Reading the letters on this account…

description: Return this account's letters, newest first, with the status, mail date and total for each. Use this to answer questions about what has already been sent. This creates nothing, changes nothing and mails nothing.

starting_after.description: The next_cursor from the previous call, to read the following page.

name: list_letters

status.description: Where the letter is. expected_delivery is the last state a standard or proof-of-mailing letter reaches; only certified tiers ever reach delivered.

total.description: An amount of money. Always read amount_cents; display is for showing the user.

amount_cents.description: The amount in whole US cents.

display.description: The amount formatted for a person, with a currency symbol.

next_cursor.description: Pass this back as starting_after for the next page.

title: List Letters
